newsitem.title: USA: NYSEG disputes CalEnergy account of meeting.
newsitem.headline: NYSEG disputes CalEnergy account of meeting.

text.p: New York State Electric and Gas Corp on Friday blasted hostile bidder CalEnergy Co Inc, saying the power company has mischaracterized a recent meeting held between the firms' top executives.

In a letter distributed to NYSEG employees, Chairman Wesley von Schack said he recently met with CalEnergy chairman David Sokol with the intention of discussing existing business relationships between the two companies.
CalEnergy earlier this week said the meeting was conducted, "to discuss the possibility of a business combination."

"Clearly, Mr Sokol came to that meeting with a much different and secret agenda. Prior to that meeting, he in no way signaled to me that he intended to engage in a discussion regarding a possible business combination," von Schack wrote in the letter obtained by Reuters.

CalEnergy quickly disputed the employee letter, saying that the agenda had been made clear to von Schack. It also noted the meeting is described in the company's filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
